notes: TL;DR: mid-market SaaS support provider using Zendesk + Freshdesk for partner portals. Primary ask = accurate, deterministic auto-tags for routing + short 1-2 sentence summaries for agents. Latency target for agent assist suggestions ~<150ms p95; throughput baseline ~200 qps, flash spikes up to 1k qps during launches. Cost-sensitive but prioritizes accuracy: target tagging precision >=85% and summary conciseness (<=40 words). Wants deterministic tag set + human-in-loop feedback for retraining. Prefers instruction-tuned open models; wants automatic fallback to smaller quantized model when dedicated pool saturated. Integration needs: Zendesk macros insertion, Freshdesk webhook transforms, mappings exported as CSV to their internal routing engine. Security: EU data residency requirement, SSO via SAML, KMS for key management, audit logs for every inference request. POC success criteria: (1) tag accuracy >=85% on anonymized holdout, (2) median agent time-to-first-suggestion reduced by 20%, (3) no PII leakage during summaries. Quote from CTO: "If tags are noisy during Black Friday we will lose trust fast. Need graceful degradation and clear fallback mapping."
additional_context: Team runs nightly ETL that normalizes ticket subjects; they expect Redwood to operate with that preprocessed stream. They want SDK + a lightweight Zendesk app to insert summaries/tags and a batch endpoint for nightly reprocessing. Mentioned fallback policy: route low-confidence tags to human queue and attach reasoning snippet.
